title: Ideas to steal
intro: Things people hand off to an agent. Tap one to make it yours — you can change the words first.

try.title: Make this one yours
try.hint: Change anything you like — the more it sounds like you, the better.
try.settingUpSub: a name, a face, their own computer

items: home
Water the fiddle-leaf every ten days — remind me, and if I send a photo, tell me if it looks sad.
home
Tell me the night before which bin goes out. The council calendar makes my head hurt.
home
The bathroom tap won't stop dripping. Work out which part it needs from my photo and where nearby sells it.
home

papers
Keep an eye on when our passports, the car's MOT and the home insurance run out, and nudge me a month early.
papers
I'll forward receipts as they come. Keep a tidy list for my tax return and flag anything I can claim.
papers

papers

out

out
Find me a two-hour walk less than an hour away by train, with a good café at the end.
out
Every Thursday, send me three things on this weekend that aren't a film or a museum.
out
Plan me a flat, quiet bike route to the office, and warn me before I leave if rain's coming.
health
It's been ages since my last dental check-up. Work out when I last went and nudge me to book.
health

health

health

family

family

family

family

work

work
